lines.trans: Once the show wraps up, will we not still meet again? After all, everyone is a producer.
Do you deserve to be called a producer? Why does Unit One work overtime every single day?
I, Chun Yuqiao, have zero time for personal favours; we have no use for you here.
Boss, what is wrong with you?
Trouble just broke out, and you fell ill.
Boss, your illness is even worse than mine.
The boss's stomach trouble has indeed grown worse and worse.
I am begging heaven to hurry and send a woman to look after our boss!
Did you not say women are the scariest? Have you forgotten Luo Lin?
Since you cannot come in to work, the chief editor's office really must find someone to cover.
Otherwise the office cannot keep up, and Xingtian really will collapse.
